technique_name: Research a famous author and summarize their accomplishments.
description: J.K. Rowling is a British author and screenwriter best known for creating the immensely popular Harry Potter book and film series. Rowling first began working on Harry Potter in 1990, while she was on a train journey from Manchester to London. She spent several years refining the plot and characters before publishing the novel in 1997.
